issues.title: The $100 week
issues.caption:
The $100 week. A hurricane, a war scare and a barrel of oil that refused to come down: global markets, 5-9 October 2026, in 20 slides.

Swipe for oil, interest rates, Wall Street's AI scare, SpaceX's surprise deal, bitcoin and gold.
